==Biography==
Born in Den Bosch, The Netherlands, '''Kirei''' started playing games at the age of 7, playing Counter Strike: Source, World of Warcraft, and Guild Wars 2 before moving on to League of Legends.

===2014 Season===
Towards the end of the season, Kirei joined [[LowLandLions.White]].

===2015 Season===
With [[LowLandLions.White|LLL.White]], Kirei qualified for the [[2015 EU Challenger Series/Spring Season|EUCS Spring Season]] via the [[2015 EU Challenger Series/Spring Qualifier|EUCS Spring Qualifier]] after the team beat [[Different Dimension]] in their bracket final. The [[2015 EU Challenger Series/Spring Season|Spring Season]] was successful for the team, finishing  in 2nd place. At this point, the team left the LowLandLions organization. In the [[2015 EU Challenger Series/Spring Playoffs|Spring Playoffs]], they beat [[Gamers2]] before joining [[Copenhagen Wolves]] to form [[Copenhagen Wolves Academy]]. They went on to lose the final to [[Origen]], meaning they would play in the [[Riot League Championship Series/Europe/2015 Season/Summer Promotion|EU LCS Summer Promotion]]. In the [[Riot League Championship Series/Europe/2015 Season/Summer Promotion|Summer Promotion]], Kirei and the team were beaten by [[Team ROCCAT]]. Soon after, [[Copenhagen Wolves Academy]] disbanded.

Part-way through the [[2015 EU Challenger Series/Summer Season|EUCS Summer Season]], Kirei replaced [[betongJocke]] as the jungler for [[Denial eSports EU]], with his predecessor coming back to sub in for the team later on in the season when Kirei was temporarily unavailable. The [[2015 EU Challenger Series/Summer Season|Summer Season]] itself was successful for Kirei and the team, finishing in 3rd place. In the [[2015 EU Challenger Series/Summer Playoffs|Summer Playoffs]], they were beaten in the semifinals by [[Team Dignitas EU]] before losing to [[Gamers2]] in the third-place match, meaning they would not have a chance to qualify for the LCS.

Kirei and the team then participated in [[PGL Legends of the Rift/Season 1|PGL Legends of the Rift - Season 1]], where they managed to top their group. [[Shook]] subbed in for Kirei during the playoffs of the tournament.

===2016 Preseason===
In November 2015, Kirei moved from Europe to North America to join [[Team Dignitas]] as part of their line-up for the [[League Championship Series/North America/2016 Season/Spring Season|NA LCS 2016 Spring Season]].<ref>[http://team-dignitas.net/articles/news/League-of-Legends/8363/announcing-the-team-dignitas-lol-roster Announcing The Team Dignitas LoL Roster] ''team-dignitas.net''</ref>
=== 2016 Season ===
Following two 1-1 weeks at the start of the season, top laner [[Smittyj]] was removed from the team's starting roster and replaced by [[BillyBoss]], due to "behavioural issues".<ref name="sjbb">[http://team-dignitas.net/articles/news/League-of-Legends/8795/billyboss-signs-as-starting-lcs-top-laner-smittyj-moved-to-sub BillyBoss Signs As Starting LCS Top Laner, SmittyJ Moved To Sub] ''team-dignitas.net''</ref> The team's worst-ever split unfolded following this change, as they saw only two further wins and – after playing the [[League Championship Series/North America/2016 Season/Spring Season/Scoreboards/Week 8#Echo Fox vs Team Dignitas|longest game of the split]] – finished 10th place with a 4-14 record. The same roster played in the [[League Championship Series/North America/2016 Season/Summer Promotion|Summer Promotion]] tournament, where they lost 0-3 to [[Team Dragon Knights]], resulting in their elimination from the LCS. This made Dignitas the first of the three original North American LCS invitee teams to be relegated from the competition.

In May, Dignitas transferred its [[NA Challenger Series/2016 Season/Summer Season|NACS Summer Season]] seed to [[Apex Gaming]], and all players left the team.<ref name="toapex">[http://team-dignitas.net/articles/news/Team-Dignitas/9465/team-dignitas-transfer-nacs-spot-to-apex-gaming Team Dignitas transfer NACS Spot To Apex Gaming] ''team-dignitas.net''</ref> Kirei returned to Europe to play for [[Epsilon eSports]] in the [[EU Challenger Series/2016 Season/Summer Season|EUCS]].

== Trivia ==
* Enjoys sports and eating sushi.
* Was studying IT while playing in Challenger Series.
